words.defn_en: half of a sphere, or one half of the Earth or another spherical body:

sentences.en: As they crossed the equator, they flew from the Northern ______ into the Southern ______.
sentences.zh: 當他們飛越赤道時，正式從北半球跨越到南半球。

sentences.en: The left ______ of the brain is traditionally associated with logical and analytical skills.
sentences.zh: 大腦左半球傳統上被認為與邏輯思考和分析能力有關。

words.defn_en: severe weakness or complete paralysis affecting only one side of the body:

sentences.en: Following his severe stroke, the patient developed ______ that paralyzed his right arm and leg.
sentences.zh: 嚴重中風後，患者出現偏癱，右手臂和右腿完全癱瘓。

sentences.en: The rehabilitation program helps patients with ______ regain mobility on their weaker side.
sentences.zh: 這項復健計畫幫助半身不遂的患者恢復較無力側的活動能力。

words.defn_en: blindness or loss of vision in half of the visual field, often caused by brain injury or stroke:

sentences.en: A tumor pressing on her optic pathway caused ______, leaving her unable to see objects on her left.
sentences.zh: 腫瘤壓迫視覺神經路徑，使她患上偏盲，無法看見左側物體。

sentences.en: People experiencing ______ must scan their surroundings to avoid objects on the blind side.
sentences.zh: 患有半盲的人必須仔細掃視周遭，以免撞到盲側的物體。

words.defn_en: having only half the number of faces required for complete crystal symmetry:

sentences.en: The scientist identified the ______ structure of the quartz by its reduced number of symmetric faces.
sentences.zh: 科學家依據對稱面數量較少的特徵，辨認出石英的半面體結構。

sentences.en: The professor explained why ______ crystals may display distinctive optical properties.
sentences.zh: 教授解釋半面體晶體為何可能呈現獨特的光學性質。

words.defn_en: a curved or semicircular structure, room, or seating arrangement:

sentences.en: The representatives gathered in the grand ______ to debate the new economic policy.
sentences.zh: 政治代表聚集在宏偉的半圓形大廳，辯論新的經濟政策。

sentences.en: The university designed the theater as a wooden ______ so every student could see the stage.
sentences.zh: 大學將劇院設計成木製半圓形構造，讓每位學生都能看見舞台。

words.defn_en: the act of cutting or dividing an organ, tooth, or other structure into two halves:

sentences.en: Instead of removing the whole tooth, the dentist performed a ______ to preserve the healthy root.
sentences.zh: 牙醫沒有拔除整顆牙齒，而是進行半切術以保留健康牙根。

sentences.en: The medical student performed a careful ______ of the spinal cord specimen for analysis.
sentences.zh: 醫學生小心地將脊髓標本剖半切開，以進行分析。

words.defn_en: pain affecting only one lateral half of the body:

sentences.en: The patient reported constant ______, with a burning sensation limited to her left side.
sentences.zh: 患者表示持續出現偏身痛，灼熱感僅限於左半身。

sentences.en: A severe nerve blockage in the spinal canal can lead to chronic ______.
sentences.zh: 脊椎管內嚴重的神經阻塞可能導致慢性半身疼痛。

words.defn_en: having two ends or halves that are structurally shaped differently from each other:

sentences.en: Tourmaline is a well-known ______ crystal because its upper and lower ends have different facets.
sentences.zh: 電氣石是著名的異極形晶體，因為上下兩端具有不同的晶面。

sentences.en: The mineral's highly ______ structure allows it to generate an electrical charge when heated.
sentences.zh: 這種礦物高度異極的結構使它受熱時能產生電荷。

words.defn_en: a parasitic plant that takes some nourishment from a host but can also photosynthesize:
words.defn_zh: 半寄生植物；半寄生生物
words.root_note: hemi- (half or partial) + parasite (organism living from a host)

sentences.en: Mistletoe is a ______ because it takes water from trees while producing energy in its own leaves.
sentences.zh: 槲寄生是半寄生植物，會從樹木吸收水分，同時用自己的葉片製造能量。

sentences.en: Although one ______ may not kill a host tree, thousands can seriously restrict forest growth.
sentences.zh: 雖然單一半寄生植物不會殺死宿主樹，但數以千計時會嚴重阻礙森林生長。

words.defn_en: a compound containing half a molecule of water for each molecule of the compound:

sentences.en: Plaster of Paris is a calcium sulfate ______ that hardens when mixed with water.
sentences.zh: 熟石膏是硫酸鈣半水合物，與水混合後會變硬。

sentences.en: The chemist heated the crystals until the compound reached a stable ______ state.
sentences.zh: 化學家加熱晶體，直到化合物達到穩定的半水合物狀態。

words.defn_en: a loss of physical feeling or sensitivity on only one side of the body:
words.defn_zh: 偏身感覺喪失；半身麻木

sentences.en: After the accident, the patient experienced sudden ______ and could not feel pressure on his left leg.
sentences.zh: 車禍後，患者突然出現偏身感覺喪失，感覺不到左腿受到的壓力。

sentences.en: Temporary ______ in an older patient can be an important warning sign of stroke.
sentences.zh: 老年患者出現暫時性半身麻木，可能是中風的重要警訊。

words.defn_en: a complex operation in which one cerebral hemisphere is removed or disconnected:

sentences.en: To stop the life-threatening seizures, the surgical team performed a rare ______.
sentences.zh: 為了阻止危及生命的癲癇發作，手術團隊進行罕見的大腦半球切除術。

sentences.en: Children who undergo a ______ may recover remarkably because the young brain can reorganize functions.
sentences.zh: 接受大腦半球切除術的兒童可能恢復得相當好，因為年幼的大腦能重新組織功能。
